rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip code, matched to a single user, then retrieved and reviewed recent orders. It correctly identified the only delivered order eligible for return, confirmed the exact items to return (excluding the tablet), and asked for/reflected the preferred refund method. It obtained explicit confirmation before performing the return write. The tool call shows the correct items and payment method, and the post-action status matched the tool output. The final refund amounts were calculated accurately based on item prices. No policy violations such as acting on another account, writing without confirmation, or fabricating key facts were observed. Minor mention of an email confirmation was plausible and not material to the outcome.
